summary: Independent verification of the Per-User Council Models feature (backend + frontend). Backend: new pytest suite /app/backend/tests/test_user_council.py (17 tests) covering GET/PUT/DELETE /api/config/council, validation (<2 models, chairman not in council, empty list), chairman defaulting to first model, persistence across a new session (new cookie, same user), /api/config overlay for non-admins, admin isolation (admin GET /api/config unaffected by any user council + global default untouched), isolation between two fresh non-admins, and admin-only gating on PUT /api/config (openrouter_api_key, lm_studio_urls => 403). 17/17 PASSED (one initial failure was a test bug on my side: lm_studio_urls is a dict, not a list - fixed in the test). Frontend: Playwright runs for a FRESH non-admin (random qauserXXXXXX@example.com) and for the admin (somecedric@gmail.com) via dev-login. Non-admin: API Settings tab absent, catalogue edit/delete buttons and 'Add Custom Model' section and edit-model-btn-* all absent (0), remove-model-btn-* present, Save Council disabled at 1 model, saving 3 models issued exactly one PUT /api/config/council (zero PUT /api/config), toast 'Council saved!', 'Reset to default' (btn-reset-council) then appeared and clicking it issued DELETE /api/config/council, hid the button and restored the global default (openai/gpt-4o-mini + anthropic/claude-3.5-sonnet). Admin: API Settings tab present, 32 catalog-edit + 32 catalog-delete buttons, edit-model-btn-* present, 'Add Custom Model' visible, no btn-reset-council, and Save Council issued PUT /api/config (global). Global council restored to its original value after testing. No backend tracebacks; no console errors other than the expected pre-login 401 on /api/auth/me.

minor.issue: No validation that the submitted model ids exist in the model catalogue, and duplicates are accepted (e.g. ['x/y','x/y'] would pass the >=2 check). Low risk since the UI can only emit catalogue ids, but a hand-crafted request can persist junk/duplicate council entries.

An admin calling this endpoint stores a PERSONAL council that is silently ignored everywhere (GET /api/config and _inject_user_council paths use the global for admins). Harmless but dead state; consider 403 or documenting it.

issues: The provider tab strip inside the model picker is horizontally clipped - the last tab renders as 'DeepS' cut at the panel edge with no visible scroll affordance/arrows.

action_items: Optional hardening: validate council_models against the catalogue and de-duplicate in PUT /api/config/council.
Optional: decide behaviour for an admin hitting PUT /api/config/council (currently writes unused per-user state).
Minor CSS: make the provider tab strip scrollable/wrappable so the last provider tab isn't clipped.
critical_code_review_comments: Council overlay is correctly read-only w.r.t. the global keys: PUT /api/config/council only writes user_council:{uid}/user_chairman:{uid}, verified by asserting default_council_models and admin GET /api/config stay unchanged.
DELETE /api/config/council is idempotent (200 + is_custom=false) on a user who never customised - good.
Settings.jsx role routing (loadConfiguration/handleSaveModels) matches the backend contract; verified at network level that non-admins never touch PUT /api/config.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 5 requested frontend behaviours verified for both roles)
